title: Moki & Julio: A chaotic invariant set in the loss-modulated class-B laser - a computer-assisted proof
description: The class-B laser rate equations with modulated losses (Oppo 2025, arXiv:2510.18472, Eq. 27), a two-variable description of loss-modulated lasers such as the 1982 Florence CO2 laser, have no rigorous chaos proof that we could find; their chaos rests on simulations. At the review's own parameters (mu = 2, eps = 0.04, omega = 1.1, m = 0.0608) we prove, with rigorous interval-arithmetic integration (CAPD), 25 covering relations for the once-per-modulation map on 24 disjoint sets built along a period-6 saddle orbit and a homoclinic excursion. Hence the map has a compact invariant chaotic set: it carries infinitely many periodic orbits and topological entropy at least 0.0537 per modulation period, and P24 has a full two-symbol shift on part of it. Numerically (not proved), the long-run motion at these parameters is a stable period-16 cycle in the last steps of the period-doubling cascade, so the proved chaos coexists with a periodic attractor. Two independently written checkers, positive and negative controls, review-seat cross-checks and a one-command reproduction are included. Text and figures CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
